description: Screenshot of Q drop 2871 (Feb 25 2019, board ID 285daf, No.5377668, QEUROPE watermark) embedding two screenshots of 2013 tweets from comedian Patton Oswalt's verified account, with two twitter.com links and Q's commentary asking who will 'fall post Weinstein'. The embedded tweets contain crude pedophilia-themed lines; the second carries the hashtag #CareerEndingTwitterTypos, marking them as Oswalt's deliberately outrageous joke tweets, while the drop presents them as sincere admissions.

description: Screenshot of Q drop 2904 (Feb 26 2019, ID 1e2b4e, No.5402283) titled 'The Armor of God'. The drop is a quotation of the Armor of God passage from the Bible (Ephesians 6:10-18, New International Version wording), signed Q, with no additional commentary.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI (ID: 1e2b4e) No.5402283. 2904. Feb 26 2019 18:56:40 (EST). The Armor of God. Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power. Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil's schemes. For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms. Therefore put on the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you may be able to stand your ground, and after you have done everything, to stand. Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness in place, and with your feet fitted with the readiness that comes from the gospel of peace. In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one. Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God. And pray in the Spirit on all occasions with all kinds of prayers and requests. With this in mind, be alert and always keep on praying for all the Lord's people. Q

description: Photograph of a person standing at an iron fence in front of a large welcome billboard in India, holding a white sheet of paper reading 'WWG1WGA' up over their face. The billboard shows Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump with Indian and U.S. flag ribbons and bilingual English/Hindi labels, consistent with the 'Namaste Trump' welcome signage for Trump's February 2020 state visit to India. The sign-holder's face is fully covered by the paper.
text: WELCO…. WWG1WGA. Shri Narendra Modi. Mrs. Melania Trump. First Lady of the United States of America. श्रीमती मेलानिया ट्रम्प. संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका की प्रथम महिला
flags: The sign-holder is a private individual and is not identifiable (face covered); billboard occasion (Feb 2020 Trump India visit) inferred from content, exact city not shown

description: Night photograph of six soldiers in multicam camouflage with helmets, night-vision mounts and rifles, posing on a flightline holding a large U.S. flag. All six faces are deliberately blurred. Behind them is a twin-nacelle tiltrotor aircraft consistent with a V-22 Osprey, its rotor tips tracing faint circles and a red anti-collision light glowing on top. The gear and anonymization are consistent with a special-operations team photo.
flags: Faces are blurred; the service members are unidentified and unidentifiable by design
Aircraft identified as consistent with a V-22 Osprey from silhouette, not markings; unit, location and date not shown
